data.one_liner: Implementation of the Connect protocol for Dart, supporting Protobuf, gRPC, and gRPC-Web.
data.what_it_does: Connect-Dart provides type-safe and idiomatic Dart clients to communicate with application servers using Protocol Buffers. It works with the Connect, gRPC, and gRPC-Web protocols, generating clean client code from your Protobuf schemas.
use_when: You are using Protocol Buffers for your backend API communication.
You need to support Connect, gRPC, or gRPC-Web protocols in your Dart application.
You want type-safe, generated clients with support for unary and streaming RPCs.
avoid_when: Your backend relies solely on REST/JSON APIs without gRPC or Connect support.
You prefer writing manual HTTP requests over code generation.
strengths: Type-safe and idiomatic clients generated from Protobuf schemas.
Supports Connect, gRPC, and gRPC-Web protocols.
Handles both unary calls and bi-directional or server streaming out of the box.
weaknesses: Requires using Protocol Buffers and code generation setup.
Depends on the V6 Protobuf runtime and requires Dart 3.7.
data.setup_notes: Requires defining Protobuf schemas and generating Dart client code, as well as importing the required runtime dependencies.
